purpose: Freeze the NAP 2.0 contract surface observed by Star Trek F14 without claiming an installed or executed Star Trek Universe Profile.

capability_assessment.note: The existing Star Trek fixture proves traceability structure only; it is explicitly not production art.
F07 can audit GLB structurally, but NAP v4 evidence reviewed here does not establish a Star Trek GLB production profile.
Do not infer audio package/conversion support from the generic package model.
UE5 import, cooking, LOD, streaming and in-build operation require execution on the MSI and independent evidence.

guardrails: Do not copy Nimroel classification or routing rules into Star Trek by analogy.
Do not call a Star Trek NAP profile installed until NAP contains and validates that profile.
Do not claim a media format is supported because Package Contract v1 accepts a syntactically safe extension.
Preserve original binaries and hashes; derivatives require separate identity/provenance records.
Rights metadata is not distribution permission.
NAP completion does not prove UE5 functionality; UE5 evidence is a separate gate.
